scripts.test: npm run typecheck:test && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --test -r ts-node/register tests/*.test.ts tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run typecheck:test && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --test -r ts-node/register tests/*.test.ts
scripts.test:validator: npm run typecheck:test && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --test -r ts-node/register tests/study.validator.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run typecheck:test && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --test -r ts-node/register tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.test:redis: npm run typecheck:test && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --test -r ts-node/register tests/integration/redis.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:redis:load: npm run typecheck:test && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --test -r ts-node/register tests/load/redis.load.test.ts
scripts.test:product: npm run typecheck:test && npm run build && npm --prefix ../Frontend run build && TS_NODE_PROJECT=tsconfig.test.json node --test -r ts-node/register tests/product/production-stack.test.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm --prefix ../Frontend run lint && npm test && npm run test:redis:load && npm run test:product
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && mkdir -p dist/src && cp -r src/generated src/views dist/src/ && cp -r public dist/
scripts.dev:workers: BACKGROUND_RUNTIME_ROLE=worker ENABLE_EMAIL_WORKER=true nodemon --watch src --exec ts-node src/worker.ts
